notes:
Refers to formally recording information in an official or organized system. Used for both official registrations (trademark, residency, vehicle) and everyday digital contexts (creating accounts, signing up for services).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{会員|かいいん}{登録|とうろく}→会員登録：22815_kaiintouroku⟧: member registration
- ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{登録|とうろく}する: register an address
- ⟦{登録|とうろく}{番号|ばんごう}→登録番号：26108_tourokubangou⟧: registration number
- ⟦{商標|しょうひょう}→商標：12019_shouhyou⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧: trademark registration
- ⟦ユーザー→ユーザー：05393_yuuzaa⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧: user registration
- ⟦{登録|とうろく}{済|ず}み→登録済み：27240_tourokuzumi⟧: registered; already registered

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}る→届け出る：05910_todokederu⟧: to notify; to file (a report) — used for submitting official notices to government offices, such as a marriage registration or change of address
- ⟦{申請|しんせい}する→申請する：25228_shinseisuru⟧: to apply — implies requesting approval or permission, while ⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧ simply records information
- ⟦{記録|きろく}する→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧: to record — focuses on keeping a record of information or events, not necessarily in an official registry
